Segmenter

The Segmenter object enables locale-sensitive text segmentation, so you can get meaningful items from a string.

Constructor

Segmenter()
Creates a new Segmenter object, which takes a locale and an options bag as arguments.

Static methods

Segmenter.supportedLocalesOf()

Usage

Segmenting a string works by calling segment on the instance and iterating the result lazily as you go.
